title: Event Interaction in Low-Rank Bottlenecks for Temporal Relation Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2609.06731v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Temporal relation extraction determines whether an event occurs before, after, or simultaneously with another event, and therefore relies on accurately modeling how the two events interact. Mainstream systems achieve this by concatenating event spans or using shallow fusion, which works well when all model parameters are trainable. However, in parameter-efficient fine-tuning, low-rank bottlenecks restrict information flow and prevent these interaction signals from passing through, leading to clear performance drops. To address this limitation, we propose a theoretically grounded architecture, Convolutional Bottleneck Interaction (CBI), which first applies lightweight depthwise convolution to enhance event representations and then uses element-wise multiplication to capture effective event-event interactions inside the bottleneck. translated_title: 面向时间关系抽取的低秩瓶颈中的事件交互
translated_abstract: 时间关系抽取用于判断一个事件是先于、后于还是同时于另一个事件发生，因此依赖于对两个事件之间如何交互的准确建模。主流系统通过拼接事件片段或使用浅层融合来实现这种交互，当所有模型参数均可训练时效果良好。然而，在参数高效微调中，低秩瓶颈限制了信息流动，使这些交互信号无法通过，导致明显的性能下降。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种有理论依据的架构——卷积瓶颈交互（CBI），它首先利用轻量级深度卷积增强事件表示，然后在瓶颈内部使用逐元素乘法来捕获有效的事件-事件交互。在Adapter和LoRA两种设置下的五个数据集和七个骨干模型上，CBI带来了一致的（性能提升）。
tldr: 提出卷积瓶颈交互（CBI）架构，通过轻量级深度卷积增强事件表示，并在低秩瓶颈内利用逐元素乘法捕捉事件间交互，解决了参数高效微调中交互信号无法通过低秩瓶颈导致性能下降的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Convolutional Bottleneck Interaction (CBI), which enhances event representations with lightweight depthwise convolution and captures event-event interactions via element-wise multiplication inside low-rank bottlenecks, resolving the performance drop caused by blocked interaction signals in parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
